## Highlights
### Fixed
- Site Controls now describes a site’s connection the same way whichever engine shows the page. - An extension managed by a policy no longer offers to enable, disable, pin or remove it, and a copy of an extension stops when the Space it goes to starts being deleted. - When an extension chosen during import can’t be installed in one Space, the other Spaces that chose it still receive it. - An extension chosen during import still reaches its other Spaces when one of them is being deleted while the extension installs.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
